# Support & Community Guidelines

Thank you for using **Page2Divi**!

## Passion Project Notice & Support Boundary

Page2Divi is an independent, free desktop utility created and maintained by **David @ RemarkablePC**. 

Because this tool is provided 100% free of charge and maintained during personal time:

* **No 1-on-1 Technical Support**: We cannot provide private migration assistance, bespoke layout debugging, direct email assistance, or guaranteed support via phone, website contact forms, or direct messages.
* **No SLAs or Guaranteed Response Times**: Inquiries and discussion threads are reviewed purely at the creator's discretion and personal availability.

## Where to Connect & Get Help

* **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/remarkablepc/Page2Divi/discussions)**: If you run into an unexpected conversion result, have bench observations, or want to share feedback with fellow designers, join the conversation in our GitHub Discussions forum. (If sharing source HTML samples and converted JSON, please ensure sensitive client credentials or private tokens are redacted first).
* **Documentation & FAQs**: Check our [README.md](README.md) for detailed explanations on HTML sanitization, Divi 4 and Divi 5 variable exports, and local offline handling.
